About this item

  • Super Durability Drop Resistant & IP64 Protection : Built to handle real-life usage with confidence. Spark Go 3’s sturdy design, drop resistance, and IP64-rated protection safeguard the device against accidental splashes, dust, and everyday bumps.
  • Smooth 120Hz Industry Leading Display : Experience ultra-fluid scrolling and crisp visuals on an Smooth 120Hz display. Whether browsing, watching, or reels scrolling, everything feels smoother and more responsive.
  • Make Calls without Network* : Stay connected even in No signal areas. Spark Go 3 allows essential calling support without active network coverage in limited range, ensuring communication when it matters the most. TnC Apply.
  • "Ella Al in Your Own Language : Ella AI understands and interacts in your preferred regional language, making daily tasks simpler, more intuitive, and more personal.A smart assistant that truly feels local. TnC Apply"
  • Premium Flagship Design : A stylish, modern build that stands out. Spark Go 3 combines refined craftsmanship with bold color finishes, offering a premium flagship-like look and feel in an accessible package.
  • Long Lasting Big Battery : Designed to keep up with long days and longer routines. The 5000mAh battery ensures extended usage without frequent charging breaks, supporting uninterrupted learning, entertainment, and communication.

    About this Item

    • Super Durability Drop Resistant & IP64 Protection : Built to handle real-life usage with confidence. Spark Go 3’s sturdy design, drop resistance, and IP64-rated protection safeguard the device against accidental splashes, dust, and everyday bumps.
    • Smooth 120Hz Industry Leading Display : Experience ultra-fluid scrolling and crisp visuals on an Smooth 120Hz display. Whether browsing, watching, or reels scrolling, everything feels smoother and more responsive.
    • Make Calls without Network* : Stay connected even in No signal areas. Spark Go 3 allows essential calling support without active network coverage in limited range, ensuring communication when it matters the most. TnC Apply.
    • "Ella Al in Your Own Language : Ella AI understands and interacts in your preferred regional language, making daily tasks simpler, more intuitive, and more personal.A smart assistant that truly feels local. TnC Apply"
    • Premium Flagship Design : A stylish, modern build that stands out. Spark Go 3 combines refined craftsmanship with bold color finishes, offering a premium flagship-like look and feel in an accessible package.
    • Long Lasting Big Battery : Designed to keep up with long days and longer routines. The 5000mAh battery ensures extended usage without frequent charging breaks, supporting uninterrupted learning, entertainment, and communication.

    Product description

    Spark Go 3 is built for real India, where days are busy, life moves fast, and reliability matters more than specs on paper. Its super-durable body, drop resistance, and IP64 protection ensure it survives the everyday mishaps everyone faces: the slips, the spills, the knocks, and the moments when life gets a little rough. The experience becomes even more personal with Ella AI, which understands you in your own language and makes the phone feel local, approachable, and genuinely helpful. Even when the network disappears in remote areas or crowded zones, Spark Go 3 keeps essential communication alive with its make-calls-without-network capability, reducing the fear of being disconnected when it matters most. And all of this plays out on a smooth 120 Hz industry-leading display that makes every swipe feel fluid and every moment look better, whether you’re learning, hustling, or simply scrolling through life.
